name: Lasse Kreimendahl
bio: Lasse completed his B.Sc. in Chemistry at the University of Würzburg in 2022, specializing in computational chemistry in the group of Prof. Roland Mitrić. During his master's studies in Würzburg, he came into contact with the Greenfield group, where he provided theoretical support for the initial development of imine photoswitches and has remained closely involved ever since. In 2024, he began his PhD at the University of Würzburg under the supervision of Dr. Merle Röhr and Prof. Roland Mitrić, focusing on combining machine learning with computational and experimental approaches to advance photoresponsive materials.
